sre_alex: Heads-up — apiserver p95 in eu-west1 jumped ~3x at 02:13 UTC. controller-manager is flapping (restart loops) and a bunch of pods show Pending with attach errors. Anyone see a correlated event?
ml_infra_jade: seeing the same. etcd leader is getting grpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and WAL fsync spikes at same time. Logs: ```etcdserver: read WAL: EOF
etcdserver: could not commit entry: EOF
rpc: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded```
oncall_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-314 — apiserver high-latency / control-plane instability (eu-west1)
engops_ben: this lined up with the GPU onboarding batch that started at 02:10 — ~120 nodes attaching GPUs. conntrack table high and SNAT allocations hammered. netstat: ```tcp 0 0 10.0.0.5:443 10.1.1.2:53212 ESTABLISHED/user 65535 conns```
netops_mina: confirmed high SNAT churn and NAT gateway CPU at 95%. Also saw proxy rate-limit kicks on the egress path. We had an asymmetric route change at 02:11 to route through the new infra NAT cluster for the GPU pool.
ml_infra_jade: attach storm + SNAT exhaustion would explain apiserver request drops and leader election noise. etcd writes are getting delayed because apiserver retries pile up and controller-manager times out waiting on updates.
sre_alex: can we mitigate quickly? rolling restarts risk more churn.
engops_ben: short term: 1) bump conntrack + SNAT ephemeral port range on gateways, 2) pause the GPU onboarding job, 3) scale apiserver replicas to absorb fanout (if WAL/io allows).
netops_mina: I'm enabling SNAT autoscaling and increasing ephemeral port range on the NATs now, also reverting the asymmetric route so egress goes via the stable path — pushing change in 2m.
ml_infra_jade: also recommend throttling concurrent attach ops in the onboarding controller: `--max-attach-concurrency=8` and add exponential backoff on failures. Can patch and roll canary to staging first.
sre_alex: good. Ben — quick cost question: if we reserve extra NAT capacity / reserved GPUs in eu-west1 to avoid this kind of tail pain, what's the rough delta?
engops_ben: rough numbers: reserving 100 GPUs ~ $85k/month (discounted yearly ~ $70k/month). Current spot/preemptible fleet avg spend ~ $28k/month but variance -> outages cost customer SLOs. Hard to calc exact hit but ops toil + incident loss ~ on order of multiple $10k per severe outage.
netops_mina: mitigation applied by netops_mina — SNAT autoscaling enabled and route reverted. NAT CPU down to 45% and conntrack cleared. Monitoring shows apiserver p95 trending down.
oncall_bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-314 status: mitigation applied (netops_mina). Follow-up required: postmortem + capacity changes.
sre_alex: thanks all. Action items: 1) jade open postmortem and add onboarding rate limit canary; 2) ben run cost model for reserved GPUs + NAT autoscale baseline; 3) mina add NAT autoscale runbook and alerting for SNAT exhaustion. I'll keep the incident open until metrics stable for 1h. :thumbsup:
ml_infra_jade: I'll create the ticket now and include logs / timeline.
engops_ben: will draft cost numbers and put in the follow-up doc.
netops_mina: will add runbook and test SNAT scale in staging tonight.
